title: Note2Input
description: Let's you control your game with 🎶Sound🎶
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bef4027fbb9dccca220d57c29686e49cabf6e75.png)
Control Minecraft with your musical instrument. Yes, actually.

***Note2Input*** lets you bind in-game actions to detected sound pitch from your microphone

---

# What it does:
- Detects microphone input in real time.
- Analyzes pitch.
- Triggers keybindings. (configurable)

---

# Features:
- Fully customizable pitch to key mappings.
- Input selection and gate.
- Output (feedback) selection and gate.
- Master toggle.
- Signal gain.

--- 

# Notes:
- It is recommended to use an audio interface instead of a normal microphone, I used the Motu M2 with a bass guitar plugged in when developing this.
- Sadly this is slightly vibe coded, i know basically nothing about audio input and pitch detection. But i did do most other work
- PvP performance not guaranteed unless you are davie504 ;)
